title: A/A: configuration A against itself, startup under high latency (the harness's own check before PB-AB-002)

hypotheses.text: Both arms run configuration A, so the harness must not find a difference: a primary metric that is significant after Holm's correction, or a verdict of A better or B better, counts as the harness finding a difference that is not there.

conditions.rationale: The condition of PB-AB-002, so that the harness is checked on the condition it will decide on: 300 ms before the first byte of every response makes every download measurable by the player's estimator, for the whole session.

metrics.thresholdBasis: A tenth of a second is the smallest change in the time to the first frame that a viewer notices on a page load, so a smaller difference is not a reason to change a default. It is the number PB-AB-002 will use unless this pilot says the design cannot detect it.

decisionRule.text: The rule of the experiments, applied to two copies of configuration A: four verdicts (A better, B better, equivalent within the margin, inconclusive). The harness passes this check when no primary metric is significant after Holm's correction and the verdict is neither A better nor B better, and when the A/A calibration of the pool of sessions (2000 random splits) does not show its false-positive rate above alpha.

exclusionRule.text: A session that errors or times out is a failed session: it is reported and never silently dropped; its metrics are left out of the comparison. The number of sessions is fixed in advance: there is no interim analysis, no extension and no re-run to improve a result.
